prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a parking lot collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1206; do not mention it.)
text:
This firm represents the individual injured in the parking lot collision described in the enclosed materials. Effective immediately, please direct all communications regarding this claim to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, or electronic means. Our client is currently receiving medical care for injuries sustained in the incident, and we ask that any adjuster assigned to this matter respect that arrangement.

Please provide, within ten business days, a certified copy of the policy declarations page showing all liability coverage limits applicable to the insured driver, along with confirmation of any additional coverage that may apply to this loss.

We also request that your company preserve all evidence relating to this incident. This includes photographs, dashcam or surveillance video, vehicle data, witness statements, recorded calls, claim file notes, repair estimates, and any other documentation in your possession. Please suspend any routine deletion or disposal procedures that could affect these materials.

We look forward to your prompt written response.
